items.b: CHENG KAR SHUN BUYS 5,000,000 CHOW TAI FOOK SHARES FOR HK$54.82M
items.t: Five Form 3A filings at the Hong Kong exchange cover 18 to 24 September. The purchases ran through Dragon Noble Group, a British Virgin Islands company he wholly owns, and his stake moved from 0.25% to 0.30%.

items.b: CELLULAR JAMMERS NAMED THE FASTEST-GROWING JEWELRY-THEFT TACTIC
items.t: A Glendale, California store lost more than $1m of inventory while its alarm sat online and raised nothing. The JSA puts violence in 27.1% of 2025 jewelry crimes, against 16.9% in 2024.

items.b: LONDON'S SILVER FIX LANDS AT 65.015, UP 2.26% ON THURSDAY
items.t: Gold's PM fix fell to 4,261.05 and palladium's to 1,256.75, while Kitco's Friday screen closed higher on all four metals on its own measure of change.

items.b: HANCOCKS AND GRIMA SHOW FIVE PIECES BUILT ON FRENCH CUTS
items.t: The series took three years and each piece carries both houses' makers' marks. One pair of earrings holds 8.19 carats, and every price is on request.

items.b: BRILLIANT EARTH PRICES AN ELIZABETH TAYLOR COLLECTION FROM $995
items.t: Seventeen lab-grown pieces went on sale on 24 September, topping out at $15,000 for a tennis necklace of 17.66 cts. t.w.
